metadata.question: Does tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels in Taiwan increase during April 20-May 12, 2020 compared to February 10-25, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 OFFL (fallback to NRTI) over a Taiwan bounding polygon. Compare two periods: 2020-02-10 to 2020-02-25 and 2020-04-20 to 2020-05-12.
2. Masking strategy: Mask low-quality pixels using qa_value >= 0.75. Compute spatial means at 10 km scale.
3. Validation: Check collection sizes (C1). Compute total vs valid pixel counts (C2). Validate means are finite and within plausible [0, 0.01] mol/m^2 (C3). Output A if P2 > P1, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const taiwan = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([119.9, 21.7, 122.2, 25.4], null, false);
    const period1 = { name: 'P1 Feb10-25', start: '2020-02-10', end: '2020-02-26' }; // end is exclusive
    const period2 = { name: 'P2 Apr20-May12', start: '2020-04-20', end: '2020-05-13' };

    // 2. Helper functions
    function maskNO2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('qa_value');
      const mask = qa.gte(0.75);
      return img.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').updateMask(mask);
    }
    async function getMaskedCollection(start, end, geom) {
      const offl = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .map(maskNO2);
      let count = await offl.size().getInfo();
      if (count === 0) {
        const nrti = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2')
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(geom)
          .map(maskNO2);
        const ncount = await nrti.size().getInfo();
        return { col: nrti, count: ncount, src: 'NRTI' };
      }
      return { col: offl, count: count, src: 'OFFL' };
    }
    async function computeStats(col, geom) {
      const meanImg = col.mean();
      const totalCount = await ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('one').getInfo();
      const validCount = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();
      const meanVal = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();
      return {
        total: (totalCount == null) ? 0 : totalCount,
        valid: (validCount == null) ? 0 : validCount,
        mean: meanVal,
      };
    }
    function invalidMean(val) {
      return (val == null || !isFinite(val) || val < 0 || val > 0.01);
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Checks
    const p1 = await getMaskedCollection(period1.start, period1.end, taiwan);
    const p2 = await getMaskedCollection(period2.start, period2.end, taiwan);

    if ((p1.count || 0) === 0 || (p2.count || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`${period1.name} Images: ${p1.count || 0} [${p1.src || 'NA'}]`);
      console.log(`${period2.name} Images: ${p2.count || 0} [${p2.src || 'NA'}]`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Processing and Validation (pixel counts)
    const s1 = await computeStats(p1.col, taiwan);
    const s2 = await computeStats(p2.col, taiwan);

    const vPct1 = s1.total > 0 ? (100 * s1.valid / s1.total) : 0;
    const vPct2 = s2.total > 0 ? (100 * s2.valid / s2.total) : 0;

    console.log(`${period1.name} Images: ${p1.count} [${p1.src}]`);
    console.log(`${period1.name} Valid px: ${s1.valid} / ${s1.total} (${vPct1.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`${period2.name} Images: ${p2.count} [${p2.src}]`);
    console.log(`${period2.name} Valid px: ${s2.valid} / ${s2.total} (${vPct2.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    if (s1.valid === 0 || s2.valid === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (invalidMean(s1.mean) || invalidMean(s2.mean)) {
      console.log(`Means invalid? P1=${s1.mean}, P2=${s2.mean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation and Final Answer
    const diff = s2.mean - s1.mean;
    const ratio = s1.mean > 0 ? (s2.mean / s1.mean) : null;

    console.log(`P1 Mean NO2 (mol/m^2): ${Number(s1.mean).toExponential(3)}`);
    console.log(`P2 Mean NO2 (mol/m^2): ${Number(s2.mean).toExponential(3)}`);
    console.log(`Δ NO2 (P2-P1): ${Number(diff).toExponential(3)} | Ratio: ${ratio ? ratio.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);

    console.log(diff > 0 ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
